answer: Treat each new identity as a boat on an open ocean until it drops an anchor: a small stake locked for five epochs that is slashed if peer graders later find its answers copied. While anchored, it grazes a shared meadow of low-value tasks with capped rewards; only after the lock clears unslashed does it earn full grading weight. A sybil farm must lock stake per fake key and wait out the lock, so cloning keys costs real capital and time.
